why_it_matters.text: A fertility medicine sold as Clomid, used to trigger ovulation. It blocks the brain's estrogen sensors, which prompts more of the hormones that ripen an egg.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under ANDA 072196 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
